question_text: Was the Apple services outage a cyberattack?
answer_text: No credible source says it was, and we found no evidence that it was. Apple says an internal update caused the outage and that it was not a cyberattack; that rests on Apple's word alone.
label: Rumor

question_text: Did Apple services really go down on Nov 17?
answer_text: Yes. Apple's own status page lists the outages.
label: Confirmed

question_text: Did Apple say an internal update caused it?
answer_text: Yes, in a statement given to several outlets.
label: Confirmed

question_text: Did an internal update cause it?
answer_text: That is Apple's explanation. Apple has given no technical detail and no one has checked it independently.
label: Reported

question_text: Did Apple say it was not a cyberattack?
label: Confirmed

question_text: Was it part of a coordinated attack with the week's other outages?
answer_text: The White House says there is no indication of a coordinated cyberattack or hostile actor behind the recent outages.
label: Debunked
